BiblicalUsage: This word is the poor and helpless, the ones the wicked hunt. The wicked sits in the lurking places with his eyes set against the poor, he crouches so the poor may fall by his strong ones, and the poor commits himself to God, who is the helper of the fatherless.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God is the helper of the helpless in this psalm, and the poor who commits himself to Him is not left alone. The wicked crouches, but God sees it and will requite it with His hand.
